name: FlutterFlow
tagline: FlutterFlow is a visual app builder on top of Google's Flutter framework, letting teams design and ship production-grade iOS, Android, and web apps without writing most of the code. Its AI assistant can generate full pages from a text description and suggests components as you build. It's popular with agencies and startups that need native-quality apps but don't have a mobile dev on staff.
